game.name: Swabby
game.desc: Swabby is a puzzle-action game for the Sega Game Gear in which you control a small cleaning robot tasked with scrubbing coloured tiles across a series of increasingly tricky stages. Push tiles into matching groups to clear them before time runs out. A delightful homebrew title with clean visuals and addictive gameplay that makes great use of the Game Gear's portable format.
